content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Help draft press releases and statements, circulate them to PIN's media network and publish them on its website when due."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Assist in developing communications and social-media plans."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Support execution of communications strategies in collaboration with the communications team, other departments and stakeholders."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Create engaging English- and French-language content for PIN's social-media channels."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Translate organizational content between French and English."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Support media monitoring and track news relevant to PIN's work."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Under the Officer's direction, schedule and publish daily posts on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, following the communications/social calendars, stated entry deadlines and communications policy."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Monitor social comments and messages, escalate critical issues to the Officer and answer routine inquiries using pre-approved guidelines."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Collect raw platform analytics weekly and compile them in a standardized report for the Officer's review."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Prepare campaign visuals and multimedia, including images, simple graphics and short videos."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Proofread communications materials and coordinate their production."},{"requirement_id":"R12","evidence":"Research and gather information and data for content and communications strategy."},{"requirement_id":"R13","evidence":"Pitch and secure coverage for PIN in at least three media outlets or publications each quarter."},{"requirement_id":"R14","evidence":"Provide detailed, accurate activity reports to the Communications Manager for timely publication when required."},{"requirement_id":"R15","evidence":"Work toward the stated target of increasing engagement across PIN's social platforms by 5% each quarter through positive mentions, shares, likes and other interactions."}]}
